name: Grimoire Package Store
tagline: Apps and widgets made for Grimoire.

packages.name: Fixture App
packages.author: Grimoire tests
packages.summary: A tiny full-screen app for trying the Store and the app host.
packages.description: Fixture App is the reference app package used by Grimoire's tests. It draws a small full-screen page, has a settings page, and returns Home through its own close API. It is a safe first install for checking that Package Store, the app launcher, icons and installation all work on your device.

packages.name: Timer
packages.author: Jane Doe
packages.summary: A small timer widget with seconds and a compact or large layout.
packages.description: Timer is the reference widget package used by Grimoire's tests. It shows how a widget declares its size, its settings and its icon. Open it from the editor's widget menu after installing it from the Store.
